# fjordrun_service_variables (Data Source)

A service's variables in one environment: as set (`variables`), and what the service receives (`resolved`). All sensitive. Needs the member role: for a viewer's token it is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "service_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_service_variables" "web" {
  service_id     = var.service_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}

output "database_url" {
  value     = data.fjordrun_service_variables.web.resolved["DATABASE_URL"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `resolved` (Map of String, Sensitive) With references resolved.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) As set, with references and generated values.
